schema.text: When you are on foot, even just to reach a stop or a parked vehicle, how does walking alongside or crossing high-speed roads (e.g., fast-moving or wide multi-lane roads) affect your sense of safety?

options.text: It does not affect my sense of safety
I feel slightly uncomfortable but manage
I feel unsafe and try to minimise time spent near high-speed roads
I take significantly longer routes to avoid walking alongside high-speed roads
I avoid trips that require me to walk alongside or cross high-speed roads
I don't walk alongside or cross high-speed roads

en.#When you are on foot, even just to reac: When you are on foot, even just to reach a stop or a parked vehicle, how does walking alongside or crossing high-speed roads (e.g., fast-moving or wide multi-lane roads) affect your sense of safety?
en.#It does not affect my sense of safety: It does not affect my sense of safety
en.#I feel slightly uncomfortable but manag: I feel slightly uncomfortable but manage
en.#I feel unsafe and try to minimise time: I feel unsafe and try to minimise time spent near high-speed roads
en.#I take significantly longer routes to a: I take significantly longer routes to avoid walking alongside high-speed roads
en.#I avoid trips that require me to walk a: I avoid trips that require me to walk alongside or cross high-speed roads
en.#I don't walk alongside or cross high-sp: I don't walk alongside or cross high-speed roads

it.#When you are on foot, even just to reac: Quando sei a piedi, anche solo per raggiungere una fermata o un veicolo parcheggiato, in che modo camminare lungo o attraversare strade ad alta velocità (ad esempio strade a scorrimento veloce o a più corsie) influisce sulla tua percezione di sicurezza?
it.#It does not affect my sense of safety: Non influisce sulla mia percezione di sicurezza
it.#I feel slightly uncomfortable but manag: Mi sento leggermente a disagio, ma riesco a gestire la situazione
it.#I feel unsafe and try to minimise time: Mi sento in pericolo e cerco di ridurre al minimo il tempo trascorso vicino a strade ad alta velocità
it.#I take significantly longer routes to a: Scelgo percorsi significativamente più lunghi per evitare di camminare lungo strade ad alta velocità
it.#I avoid trips that require me to walk a: Evito gli spostamenti che richiedono di camminare lungo o attraversare strade ad alta velocità
it.#I don't walk alongside or cross high-sp: Non cammino lungo strade ad alta velocità e non le attraverso

fr.#When you are on foot, even just to reac: Lorsque vous êtes à pied, même seulement pour rejoindre un arrêt ou un véhicule stationné, dans quelle mesure le fait de marcher le long de routes à grande vitesse ou de les traverser (par ex. voies rapides ou larges routes à plusieurs voies) influence-t-il votre sentiment de sécurité ?
fr.#It does not affect my sense of safety: Cela n’influence pas mon sentiment de sécurité
fr.#I feel slightly uncomfortable but manag: Je me sens un peu mal à l’aise, mais je peux continuer
fr.#I feel unsafe and try to minimise time: Je me sens en danger et j’essaie de passer le moins de temps possible près des routes à grande vitesse
fr.#I take significantly longer routes to a: Je prends des itinéraires nettement plus longs pour éviter de marcher le long des routes à grande vitesse
fr.#I avoid trips that require me to walk a: J’évite les trajets qui m’obligent à marcher le long de routes à grande vitesse ou à les traverser
fr.#I don't walk alongside or cross high-sp: Je ne marche pas le long de routes à grande vitesse et je ne les traverse pas

de.#When you are on foot, even just to reac: Wenn Sie zu Fuß unterwegs sind, auch nur um eine Haltestelle oder ein geparktes Fahrzeug zu erreichen: Wie beeinflusst es Ihr Sicherheitsgefühl, an Straßen mit schnellem Verkehr entlangzugehen oder sie zu überqueren (z. B. Schnellstraßen oder breite, mehrspurige Straßen)?
de.#I feel slightly uncomfortable but manag: Ich fühle mich etwas unwohl, komme aber zurecht
de.#I feel unsafe and try to minimise time: Ich fühle mich unsicher und versuche, möglichst wenig Zeit an Straßen mit schnellem Verkehr zu verbringen
de.#I take significantly longer routes to a: Ich nehme deutlich längere Wege, um Straßen mit schnellem Verkehr zu vermeiden
de.#I avoid trips that require me to walk a: Ich vermeide Wege, bei denen ich an Straßen mit schnellem Verkehr entlanggehen oder sie überqueren muss
de.#I don't walk alongside or cross high-sp: Ich gehe nicht an Straßen mit schnellem Verkehr entlang und überquere sie nicht

tr.#When you are on foot, even just to reac: Yaya olduğunuzda, yalnızca bir durağa veya park edilmiş bir araca ulaşmak için bile olsa, hızlı araçların olduğu yollar (ör. trafiğin hızlı aktığı veya çok şeritli geniş yollar) boyunca yürümek ya da bu yollardan karşıya geçmek güvenlik hissinizi nasıl etkiliyor?
tr.#I feel slightly uncomfortable but manag: Biraz rahatsız hissederim ama devam edebilirim
tr.#I feel unsafe and try to minimise time: Kendimi güvensiz hisseder ve hızlı araçların olduğu yolların yakınında geçirdiğim süreyi azaltmaya çalışırım
tr.#I take significantly longer routes to a: Hızlı araçların olduğu yollar boyunca yürümekten kaçınmak için belirgin şekilde daha uzun güzergâhlar kullanırım
tr.#I avoid trips that require me to walk a: Hızlı araçların olduğu yollar boyunca yürümeyi veya bu yolları geçmeyi gerektiren yolculuklardan kaçınırım
tr.#I don't walk alongside or cross high-sp: Hızlı araçların olduğu yollar boyunca yürümüyorum ve bu yollardan karşıya geçmiyorum

fa.#When you are on foot, even just to reac: وقتی پیاده هستید، حتی فقط برای رسیدن به ایستگاه یا وسیله نقلیه پارک‌شده، راه رفتن در کنار خیابان‌های پرسرعت (مثلاً خیابان‌های عریض و چندخطه یا با ترافیک سریع) یا عبور از آن‌ها چه تأثیری بر احساس امنیت شما دارد؟
fa.#It does not affect my sense of safety: بر احساس امنیت من اثری ندارد
fa.#I feel slightly uncomfortable but manag: کمی ناراحت می‌شوم، اما می‌توانم ادامه دهم
fa.#I feel unsafe and try to minimise time: احساس ناامنی می‌کنم و تلاش می‌کنم زمان کمتری نزدیک خیابان‌های پرسرعت باشم
fa.#I take significantly longer routes to a: برای دوری از خیابان‌های پرسرعت مسیرهای بسیار طولانی‌تری انتخاب می‌کنم
fa.#I avoid trips that require me to walk a: از سفرهایی که نیاز به راه رفتن در کنار یا عبور از خیابان‌های پرسرعت دارند پرهیز می‌کنم
fa.#I don't walk alongside or cross high-sp: در کنار خیابان‌های پرسرعت راه نمی‌روم و از آن‌ها عبور نمی‌کنم

hu.#When you are on foot, even just to reac: Amikor gyalog van, akár csak azért, hogy elérjen egy megállót vagy egy parkoló járművet, hogyan befolyásolja a biztonságérzetét, ha gyors forgalmú utak (pl. nagy sebességű vagy széles, többsávos utak) mentén kell gyalogolnia vagy azokon kell átkelnie?
hu.#I feel slightly uncomfortable but manag: Kissé kényelmetlenül érzem magam, de megoldom
hu.#I feel unsafe and try to minimise time: Nem érzem magam biztonságban, és igyekszem minél kevesebb időt tölteni gyors forgalmú utak közelében
hu.#I take significantly longer routes to a: Jelentősen hosszabb útvonalakat választok, hogy elkerüljem a gyors forgalmú utakat
hu.#I avoid trips that require me to walk a: Elkerülöm azokat az utakat, ahol gyors forgalmú út mellett kell gyalogolnom vagy azon kell átkelnem
hu.#I don't walk alongside or cross high-sp: Nem gyalogolok gyors forgalmú utak mentén, és nem kelek át rajtuk

ar.#When you are on foot, even just to reac: عند التنقل سيرًا على الأقدام، حتى لمجرد الوصول إلى محطة أو إلى مركبة مركونة، كيف يؤثر المشي بمحاذاة الطرق السريعة (مثل الطرق ذات الحركة السريعة أو الطرق العريضة متعددة المسارات) أو عبورها في شعورك بالأمان؟
ar.#I feel slightly uncomfortable but manag: أشعر بعدم الراحة قليلًا لكنني أستطيع التعامل مع ذلك
ar.#I feel unsafe and try to minimise time: أشعر بعدم الأمان وأحاول تقليل الوقت الذي أقضيه قرب الطرق السريعة
ar.#I take significantly longer routes to a: أختار طرقًا أطول بكثير لتجنب المشي بمحاذاة الطرق السريعة
ar.#I avoid trips that require me to walk a: أتجنب الرحلات التي تتطلب المشي بمحاذاة طرق سريعة أو عبورها
ar.#I don't walk alongside or cross high-sp: لا أمشي بمحاذاة الطرق السريعة ولا أعبرها
